paragraphs: The M340i xDrive sits at the top of the 3 Series petrol range, powered by the B58 — BMW's 3.0-litre inline-six that has earned a strong reputation for reliability and performance. Fitted to the G20 saloon and G21 Touring generations from 2019 onwards, the M340i xDrive received a 48V mild hybrid system as part of the 2022 LCI facelift, which continues through to the present day.
about.boldParagraph: The M340i xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
